# wallix.bastion.secret

Check out, extend or check in an account password on a WALLIX Bastion — module

*Added in version 1.0.0 of `wallix.bastion`.*

## Synopsis

- Retrieve the password, SSH key or SSH certificate of a target account from a WALLIX Bastion (`GET /api/<version>/targetpasswords/checkout/<target>`), extend the checkout, or release it.
- The authenticated user ([`bastion_user`](#parameter-bastion-user)) must be granted password retrieval on the account by an authorization (`authorize_password_retrieval`); the Bastion answers `NOT_AUTHORIZED` otherwise, also for an administrator.
- There is no Terraform equivalent; to read secrets from a play's templates, see the [`wallix.bastion.secret`](../lookup/secret.md) lookup.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Comments |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="parameter-account"></a>**account** | `str` / required | Name of the account. |
| <a id="parameter-api-version"></a>**api_version** | `str` | Version of the Bastion REST API to use, `v3.8` or `v3.12`.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_API_VERSION` environment variable is used, then `v3.12`. |
| <a id="parameter-application"></a>**application** | `str` | Application of the account, for an account of an application local domain.<br>The target is then `<account>@<domain>@<application>`.<br>Without [`device`](#parameter-device) and [`application`](#parameter-application), the target is `<account>@<domain>`, an account of a global domain. |
| <a id="parameter-authorization"></a>**authorization** | `str` | Name of the authorization to use when several give access to the account. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-host"></a>**bastion_host** | `str` | Hostname or IP address of the WALLIX Bastion.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_HOST` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-password"></a>**bastion_password** | `str` | Password of [`bastion_user`](#parameter-bastion-user).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_PASSWORD` environment variable is used.<br>One of [`bastion_password`](#parameter-bastion-password) or [`bastion_token`](#parameter-bastion-token) is required. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-port"></a>**bastion_port** | `int` | HTTPS port of the WALLIX Bastion API.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_PORT` environment variable is used, then `443`. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-timeout"></a>**bastion_timeout** | `int` | Timeout in seconds of each HTTP request to the Bastion API.<br><br>Default: `30` |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-token"></a>**bastion_token** | `str` | API key of [`bastion_user`](#parameter-bastion-user). Takes precedence over [`bastion_password`](#parameter-bastion-password).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_TOKEN` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-user"></a>**bastion_user** | `str` | User to authenticate with. With [`bastion_token`](#parameter-bastion-token), the user the API key belongs to.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_USER` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-cert-format"></a>**cert_format** | `str` | Format of the returned SSH certificate.<br>Only used with [`state=checkout`](#parameter-state).<br><br>Choices: `openssh`, `ssh.com` |
| <a id="parameter-comment"></a>**comment** | `str` | Reason for a forced checkin. Required when [`force=true`](#parameter-force). |
| <a id="parameter-csrf-enabled"></a>**csrf_enabled** | `bool` | Send the CSRF token the Bastion issues at login (Bastion 12.0.3 and later).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_CSRF_ENABLED` environment variable is used, then `true`. |
| <a id="parameter-device"></a>**device** | `str` | Device of the account, for an account of a device local domain.<br>The target is then `<account>@<domain>@<device>`. |
| <a id="parameter-domain"></a>**domain** | `str` / required | Domain of the account, that is the local domain of [`device`](#parameter-device) or [`application`](#parameter-application), or a global domain. |
| <a id="parameter-duration"></a>**duration** | `int` | Requested checkout duration in seconds, within the limits of the account's checkout policy.<br>Only used with [`state=checkout`](#parameter-state). |
| <a id="parameter-force"></a>**force** | `bool` | Check in an account checked out by another user. Requires the corresponding Bastion right.<br>Only used with [`state=checkin`](#parameter-state).<br><br>Default: `false` |
| <a id="parameter-key-format"></a>**key_format** | `str` | Format of the returned SSH private key. The Bastion refuses formats the key type does not support (for example `pkcs8` for an Ed25519 key).<br>Only used with [`state=checkout`](#parameter-state).<br><br>Choices: `openssh`, `pkcs1`, `pkcs8`, `putty` |
| <a id="parameter-key-passphrase"></a>**key_passphrase** | `str` | Passphrase the Bastion encrypts the returned SSH private key with.<br>Sent in the `X-Key-Passphrase` header, never in the URL.<br>Only used with [`state=checkout`](#parameter-state). |
| <a id="parameter-state"></a>**state** | `str` | `checkout` retrieves the secret and, if the account's checkout policy locks accounts, locks it for the user.<br>`extend` extends the current checkout of the user. It fails when the account is not checked out, when its checkout policy does not lock accounts, or when the maximum duration is reached.<br>`checkin` releases the checkout. An account that is not checked out is not an error and is reported unchanged.<br><br>Choices: `checkout` (default), `checkin`, `extend` |
| <a id="parameter-validate-certs"></a>**validate_certs** | `bool` | Whether to validate the Bastion's TLS certificate.<br>Only disable this for test instances with self-signed certificates.<br>If not set, `WALLIX_BASTION_VALIDATE_CERTS` is used, then the inverse of `WALLIX_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY`, then `true`. |

## Attributes

| Attribute | Support | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **check_mode** | partial<br>In check mode nothing is checked out, extended or checked in, so no secret is returned. `changed` is `true` because the Bastion has no call telling in advance whether the action would succeed.<br>Set `check_mode=false` on the task to retrieve the secret in a check mode run anyway. | Can run in check_mode and return changed status prediction without modifying target. |
| **diff_mode** | none | Will return details on what has changed (or possibly needs changing in check_mode), when in diff mode. |

## Notes

- [`state=checkout`](#parameter-state) and [`state=extend`](#parameter-state) always report `changed=true` when they succeed. Each call creates or extends a checkout on the Bastion, which locks the account for other users when the checkout policy enables locking, is recorded in the Bastion audit trail, and may make the Bastion rotate the password at checkin.
- The secret is part of the module result. A module cannot hide its own result, so set `no_log=true` on checkout tasks, or the secret is displayed with `-v` and sent to callbacks.
- Check in what you check out, or let the checkout policy expire it.
- The environment variables are the ones of the `wallix/wallix-bastion` Terraform provider, so one shell configuration serves both tools.
- Set the connection options once per play with `module_defaults` and the `group/wallix.bastion.bastion` action group.
- These modules call the Bastion API from the host they run on; use them with `delegate_to` or on a play targeting `localhost`.

## Examples

```yaml
- name: Check out the password of root on a device
  wallix.bastion.secret:
    account: root
    domain: local
    device: srv-linux-01
  register: root_secret
  no_log: true

- name: Use it
  ansible.builtin.command: /usr/local/bin/rotate-db --login "{{ root_secret.login }}"
  environment:
    DB_PASSWORD: "{{ root_secret.password }}"
  no_log: true

- name: Get an SSH key in PuTTY format, encrypted with a passphrase
  wallix.bastion.secret:
    account: deploy
    domain: local
    device: srv-linux-01
    key_format: putty
    key_passphrase: "{{ vault_key_passphrase }}"
  register: deploy_key
  no_log: true

- name: Extend the checkout
  wallix.bastion.secret:
    account: root
    domain: local
    device: srv-linux-01
    state: extend

- name: Release the account
  wallix.bastion.secret:
    account: root
    domain: local
    device: srv-linux-01
    state: checkin

- name: Release an account another user checked out
  wallix.bastion.secret:
    account: root
    domain: local
    device: srv-linux-01
    state: checkin
    force: true
    comment: Operator left without checking in
```

## Return values

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="return-checkout"></a>**checkout** | `dict` | What the Bastion returned about the checkout, without the secrets.<br>Empty for [`state=checkin`](#parameter-state) and in check mode.<br><br>Returned: always<br><br>Sample: see [below](#sample-checkout) |
| <a id="return-login"></a>**login** | `str` | Login of the account.<br><br>Returned: when [`state=checkout`](#parameter-state), not in check mode<br><br>Sample: `root` |
| <a id="return-password"></a>**password** | `str` | Password of the account. Absent when the account has no password.<br><br>Returned: when [`state=checkout`](#parameter-state), not in check mode, and the account has a password<br><br>Sample: `Sup3r-S3cret` |
| <a id="return-ssh-certificate"></a>**ssh_certificate** | `str` | SSH certificate of the account, in [`cert_format`](#parameter-cert-format).<br><br>Returned: when [`state=checkout`](#parameter-state), not in check mode, and the account has a certificate<br><br>Sample: `""` |
| <a id="return-ssh-key"></a>**ssh_key** | `str` | SSH private key of the account, in [`key_format`](#parameter-key-format), encrypted with [`key_passphrase`](#parameter-key-passphrase) when set.<br><br>Returned: when [`state=checkout`](#parameter-state), not in check mode, and the account has an SSH key<br><br>Sample: `"-----BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----
...
-----END OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----
"` |
| <a id="return-target"></a>**target** | `str` | The account target the call was made for.<br><br>Returned: always<br><br>Sample: `root@local@srv-linux-01` |

### Sample of `checkout`

```yaml
checkin_change_password: false
checkin_time: '2026-10-01 11:48:03'
deconnection_time: '2099-12-30 23:59:59'
locked: true
remaining_time: 600
ssh_key_type: ssh-ed25519
```
